name: Suricata C2 Detection Rules — Empire, Covenant, Sliver & Dridex
description: Real-world Suricata rule examples for detecting common C2 frameworks. PowerShell Empire: HTTP GET with specific URIs + base64 cookie + user-agent + missing headers. Covenant: body string '<title>Hello World!</title>' with detection_filter; OR fixed dsize:312. Sliver HTTP: URI PCRE + Set-Cookie regex. Sliver TLS: JA3 hash match. Dridex TLS: SSL certificate byte patterns + OID inspection. Demonstrates signature, anomaly, and TLS fingerprinting approaches.

Test Sliver JA3 rule against sliverenc.pcap
PSEmpire rule (full)
examples.command: alert http $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET MALWARE Possible PowerShell Empire Activity Outbound"; flow:established,to_server; content:"GET"; http_method; content:"/"; http_uri; depth:1; pcre:"/^(?:login\/process|admin\/get|news)\.php$/RU"; content:"session="; http_cookie; pcre:"/^(?:[A-Z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Z0-9+/]{3}=|[A-Z0-9+/]{4})$/CRi"; content:"Mozilla|2f|5.0|20 28|Windows|20|NT|20|6.1"; http_user_agent; http_start; content:".php|20|HTTP|2f|1.1|0d 0a|Cookie|3a 20|session="; fast_pattern; http_header_names; content:!"Referer"; content:!"Cache"; content:!"Accept"; sid:2027512; rev:1;)

examples.label: Covenant body rule (full)
examples.command: alert tcp any any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"detected by body"; content:"<title>Hello World!</title>"; detection_filter: track by_src, count 4, seconds 10; priority:1; sid:3000011;)

examples.label: Covenant analytics rule (dsize)
examples.command: alert tcp $HOME_NET any -> any any (msg:"detected by size and counter"; dsize:312; detection_filter: track by_src, count 3, seconds 10; priority:1; sid:3000001;)
